content: In 2019, she, along with Margaret Ewen from Health Action International, was awarded the Helen-Clark-JOPPP Award for Pharmaceutical Policy and Practice Research. Jo Watson is the Deputy Chair of the Australian Government Pharmaceutical Benefits Advisory Committee. She also serves as the Chair of the Health Technology Assessment Consumer Consultative Committee, the Deputy Chair of the Consumers Health Forum Australia, and has been a long-standing consumer nominee and community advocate. Rasha Ziada is the Chairperson of the Central Administration of Pharmaceutical Affairs (CAPA) at the Egyptian Government Ministry of Health and Population, which constitutes the primary component of Egypt's National Regulatory Agency. She also leads three technical committees within the Ministry of Health: the Pricing Committee, the Technical Committee for Drug Registration, and the Committee for Pharmacoeconomics.
